people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Carmel_Mount
people.line: Mountain range; site of Elijah's confrontation with prophets of Baal

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
translations.bsb: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. But Elijah climbed to the summit of Carmel, bent down on the ground, and put his face between his knees.
translations.kjv: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
translations.asv: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees.
